sources.name: Flag of the Czech Republic - Wiki
Flag of the United States - Wiki

_: 13 stacked horizontal stripes of alternating red (7) and white (6), with a dark blue rectangle in the upper left/hoist corner. Inside the blue rectangle are 50 white, five-pointed stars arranged in alternating rows of five (four rows) or six (five rows).
Two thick horizontal stripes of red (top), and white (bottom). Similar to Monaco, but wider (2:3 ratio).
Two thick horizontal stripes of white (top), and red (bottom). Similar to Indonesia and Monaco, but colors are reversed, and to Greenland, but without the circle.
14 stacked horizontal stripes of alternating red (7) and white (7), with a dark blue rectangle in the upper left/hoist corner. Inside the blue rectangle is a gold crescent moon and 14-pointed sun.
Two thick horizontal stripes of white (top), and red (bottom) with a blue rectangle in upper left and a single white, five-pointed star in the center of the blue rectangle.
Two thick horizontal stripes of white (top), and red (bottom) overlaid by a blue triangle aligned along the left/hoist edge.
Three equal horizontal stripes of (from top) red, white, and red, with a black eagle wearing a crown and holding a hammer and sickle in its talons in the center.
Two thick horizontal stripes of red (top), and white (bottom) with white crescent moon and five five-pointed stars in upper left/hoist corner.
Four horizontal stripes of (from top) red, double-thick white, and red, with a green cedar tree in the center.
11 stacked horizontal stripes of alternating red (6) and white (5), with a dark blue square in the upper left/hoist corner and a single white five-pointed star inside the square.
Stacked horizontal stripes of (from top) red, white, red, white, and red, overlaid by a blue triangle aligned along the left/hoist edge and with a single five-pointed white star in its center.
Three horizontal stripes of (from top) double-thick red, white, and double-thick red.
Horizontal stripes of (from top) red, double-thick white, and red, with an emblem in the center featuring a yellow sky, blue sea, and a red canoe with five stylized rowers.
Two thick horizontal stripes of white (top), and red (bottom) with a left-of-center circle of the opposite color (ie, red on top and white on the bottom).
Double-thick white horizontal band atop a band of red, with a red castle in the center and a gold key hanging from the castle's entryway.
Two thick horizontal stripes of red (top), and white (bottom). Similar to Indonesia, but nearly square (4:5 ratio).
